section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining the relationship between positive body image (specifically body appreciation) and sexual liberalism in an online sample of US adults. The study found that body appreciation was significantly associated with both traditional and contemporary measures of sexual liberalism in both women and men, with some gender differences noted (e.g., technology liberalism association stronger in men). The authors argue that positive body image may directly promote sex-positive behaviors and more liberal sexual attitudes, rather than merely reducing negative body image effects.
